description: Rare necrotic skull dropped by Nether fortress wither skeletons. Essential ritual catalyst placed on soul sand to construct and awaken the Wither boss.

description: Nether trophy acquired when a charged creeper slays a piglin. Flaps its ears rhythmically when powered by redstone or worn by players.

description: Colossal trophy block mounted on the bow of End Ships. Wearable as an imposing helmet, and mouth opens and closes dynamically when redstone-powered.

name: Monster Spawner
description: Ancient iron cage mechanism that perpetually materializes hostile mobs in low light when players enter within sixteen blocks.

name: Blaze Spawner
description: Nether fortress cage apparatus that continuously generates fiery blazes, serving as an automated furnace fuel and potion ingredient source.

name: Zombie Spawner
description: Subterranean dungeon cage generating undead zombies, automated by engineers to harvest rotten flesh, iron ingots, and rare equipment.

name: Skeleton Spawner
description: Subterranean cage mechanism summoning hostile archers, leveraged in industrial mob farms for renewable bone meal fertilizer and arrow ammunition.

name: Spider Spawner
description: Dungeon cage apparatus materializing wall-climbing venomous arthropods, providing automated harvests of crafting string and alchemical spider eyes.

name: Warden Spawn Egg
description: Summons the blind apex predator of the Deep Dark. Tracks vibrations, unleashes lethal sonic shrieks, and can wipe out fully netherite-armored players.

name: Wither Spawn Egg
description: Directly summons the catastrophic three-headed necrotic boss. Detonates on arrival, inflicts fatal wither decay, and drops the beacon-powering Nether Star.

name: Creeper Spawn Egg
description: Instant spawn capsule for the iconic silent ambush predator. Sneaks toward players and explodes violently, destroying surrounding terrain and structures.

name: Blaze Spawn Egg
description: Summons floating elemental sentinels of Nether fortresses that hover, emit smoke, and fire bursts of three incendiary fireballs.

name: Ghast Spawn Egg
description: Summons a colossal floating Nether phantom that screeches across cavernous skies and launches high-explosive fireballs capable of shattering terrain.

name: Enderman Spawn Egg
description: Summons an enigmatic tall humanoid capable of dimensional teleportation and picking up terrain blocks. Enrages upon direct eye contact.

name: Shulker Spawn Egg
description: Summons a defensive shell-lurking End city organism. Shoots guided levitation bullets and drops shulker shells for portable chest crafting.

name: Evoker Spawn Egg
description: Summons an elite illager caster that summons snapping ground fangs, conjures flying vexes, and yields the life-saving Totem of Undying upon defeat.

name: Vindicator Spawn Egg
description: Summons an iron axe wielding illager shock trooper that sprints aggressively toward players and villagers during mansion raids.

name: Ravager Spawn Egg
description: Summons a monstrous horned illager mount that roars with concussive shockwaves, tramples crops, and knocks back opposing combatants.

name: Witch Spawn Egg
description: Summons a hostile alchemist that hurls splash potions of poison, slowness, and damage while chugging healing draughts under fire.

name: Guardian Spawn Egg
description: Summons a prickly aquatic defender of ocean monuments that fires sustained prismarine laser beams and retaliates with defensive spikes.

name: Elder Guardian Spawn Egg
description: Summons the ancient spectral guardian boss that inflicts debilitating Mining Fatigue across ocean monuments and commands laser defenses.

name: Phantom Spawn Egg
description: Summons a swooping airborne predator that hunts players who neglect sleep for over three days. Yields durable elytra-repairing membranes.

name: Breeze Spawn Egg
description: Summons an agile Trial Chamber elemental that leaps rapidly and fires explosive wind projectiles that trigger redstone switches and dispensers.

name: Bogged Spawn Egg
description: Summons a moss-covered swamp skeleton variant that shoots poison-tipped arrows and can be sheared for edible mushrooms.

name: Silverfish Spawn Egg
description: Summons a tiny burrowing arthropod that infests stone blocks in strongholds and calls nearby swarm allies when attacked.

name: Magma Cube Spawn Egg
description: Summons a bouncing fiery slime variant immune to lava. Splits into smaller cubes upon death and drops magma cream for fire resistance potions.

name: Iron Golem Spawn Egg
description: Summons a massive iron construct that defends villagers from raiding monsters, tossing hostiles into the air with immense mechanical force.

name: Snow Golem Spawn Egg
description: Summons a snowman sentry that pelts hostile mobs with snowballs and leaves a trail of snow underfoot. Melts in hot biomes and rain.

name: Allay Spawn Egg
description: Summons a gentle winged spirit that collects and delivers dropped items matching whichever item it holds, assisting in automated collection.

name: Villager Spawn Egg
description: Summons a civilized humanoid trader capable of claiming workstations, learning professions, and exchanging emeralds for enchanted gear.

name: Wandering Trader Spawn Egg
description: Summons an itinerant merchant accompanied by two llamas, offering exotic saplings, dyes, and rare flora from distant biomes.

name: Wolf Spawn Egg
description: Summons a loyal canine companion tamable with bones. Defends its owner in combat and can be equipped with protective armadillo scute armor.

name: Cat Spawn Egg
description: Summons a domestic feline tamable with fish. Wards off creepers and phantoms, and gifts morning foraging treasures to sleeping players.

name: Axolotl Spawn Egg
description: Summons an adorable amphibious predator from lush caves that hunts drowned and guardians, playing dead to regenerate health in battle.

name: Bee Spawn Egg
description: Summons an industrious pollinating bee that gathers nectar from flowers, fertilizes crops, and manufactures sweet honey inside hives.

name: Sniffer Spawn Egg
description: Summons a gentle ancient giant that roots through dirt with its keen snout to excavate extinct decorative torchflower and pitcher crop seeds.

name: Sniffer Egg
description: Large prehistoric egg uncovered from ocean ruins. Hatches into a baby snifflet, incubating twice as fast when placed on moss blocks.

name: Armadillo Spawn Egg
description: Summons a savanna critter that rolls into a durable armored sphere when threatened. Drops scutes used to craft custom wolf armor.

name: Frog Spawn Egg
description: Summons an amphibious jumper that eats small magma cubes to produce luminous decorative froglights in temperate, warm, or cold colors.

name: Strider Spawn Egg
description: Summons a passive Nether creature that walks effortlessly across lava lakes. Rideable with a saddle and warped fungus on a stick.

name: Camel Spawn Egg
description: Summons a tall desert mount carrying two riders at once. Features a horizontal dash leap and elevates players out of melee monster reach.

name: Glow Squid Spawn Egg
description: Summons a luminescent subterranean cephalopod that drops glow ink sacs for crafting illuminated signs and glowing item frames.

name: Turtle Egg
description: Delicate reptile clutch laid on beach sands that slowly incubates into baby turtles. Highly vulnerable to trampling by zombies.

name: Bee Nest
description: Naturally occurring wild wooden colony block housing up to three pollinating bees, accumulating honey until harvested with shears.

name: Beehive
description: Crafted apiary box housing domestic bees. Emits comparator redstone signals proportional to the five internal honey saturation levels.

name: Mechanical Arm

name: Train Station

name: Display Board
description: Modular flip-digit information terminal that displays dynamic readouts from trains, scoreboards, and factory production metrics.

name: Schematicannon
description: Autonomous artillery-styled 3D construction cannon. Fires architectural blocks directly from linked chests to build imported blueprints.

name: Flywheel
description: Massive rotating iron wheel that interfaces with rotational engines to distribute rotational kinetic momentum across heavy industrial plants.

name: Item Vault

description: A water vehicle crafted from dark oak planks that carries up to two passengers. Moves swiftly across water bodies and glides rapidly over ice.

name: Dark Oak Boat with Chest
description: A dark oak boat equipped with a rear storage chest providing twenty-seven inventory slots. Transports items across water alongside a single rower.

name: Dark Oak Door
description: A solid two-block-high wooden door crafted from dark oak planks. Can be opened manually by hand or activated via redstone signal.

name: Dark Oak Hanging Sign
description: A dark wooden hanging sign crafted from stripped dark oak logs and chains. Suspends from block ceilings or walls to provide written labels.

name: Dark Oak Sign
description: A standing or wall-mounted wooden sign crafted from dark oak planks and a stick. Features customizable text fields on both front and back faces.

name: Redstone Comparator
description: A redstone logic component used to compare signal strengths, subtract values, and measure container fullness.

name: Cooked Rabbit
description: A cooked meat food item obtained by cooking raw rabbit in a furnace, smoker, or campfire. Restores five hunger points and six saturation points.

name: Creeper Banner Pattern
description: A reusable crafting stencil used in a loom to apply the Creeper charge design onto banners. It is not consumed when used in banner crafting.

name: Crimson Door
description: A fireproof wooden door crafted from Nether crimson planks. Can be opened or closed manually by hand or activated via redstone signals.

name: Crimson Sign
description: A fire-resistant standing or wall-mounted wooden sign crafted from crimson planks and a stick. Displays customizable text on both front and back faces.

name: Crossbow with Arrow
description: A primed crossbow loaded with an arrow ready for immediate firing. Deals heavy ranged projectile damage when released.

name: Crossbow with Firework
description: A primed crossbow loaded with a firework rocket ready to be launched. Detonates upon target impact to inflict area-of-effect damage.

name: Crossbow (Pulling 0)
description: A crossbow in the initial drawing stage of loading a projectile. Represents the earliest tension animation frame when charging the weapon.

name: Crossbow (Pulling 1)
description: A crossbow in the intermediate drawing stage of loading a projectile. Displays the bowstring pulled halfway back before locking.

name: Crossbow (Pulling 2)
description: A crossbow in the final drawing stage just before the bowstring locks into fully loaded position. Indicates loading is nearly complete.

name: Crossbow (Standby)
description: An unloaded crossbow resting in its idle standby state. Can be drawn and loaded with arrows or firework rockets for ranged combat.

name: Diamond Boots
description: High-tier protective footwear forged from four diamonds. Provides three armor defense points and two points of armor toughness.

name: Diamond Chestplate
description: Formidable torso armor crafted from eight diamonds. Grants eight armor defense points and two toughness points to absorb heavy damage.

name: Diamond Helmet
description: Durable protective headgear crafted from five diamonds. Bestows three armor points and two points of armor toughness against incoming damage.

name: Diamond Horse Armor
description: Loot-exclusive equine armor found in structures such as dungeons and Nether fortresses. Grants eleven armor defense points to a tamed horse with infinite durability.

name: Diamond Hoe
description: An agricultural tool crafted from two diamonds and sticks. Tills dirt and grass into farmland and breaks organic blocks like leaves and sculk rapidly.

name: Diamond Leggings
description: Sturdy protective leg armor crafted from seven diamonds. Grants six armor points and two points of armor toughness.

name: Disc Fragment 5
description: A shattered shard of Music Disc 5 discovered inside Ancient City chests. Combining nine fragments at a crafting table reconstitutes the full music disc.

name: Dried Kelp
description: An edible food item obtained by smelting harvested kelp in a furnace or smoker. Can be consumed quickly to restore hunger or compacted into fuel blocks.

name: Dune Armor Trim Smithing Template
description: A rare smithing template found in desert pyramid chests. Used at a smithing table to apply the decorative Dune trim pattern to armor using mineral ingots or crystals.

name: Echo Shard
description: A mysterious resonant crystal scavenged from Ancient City chests in the Deep Dark. Combined with a compass to craft a Recovery Compass.

name: Empty Map
description: A blank cartographic chart crafted from paper and a compass. Right-clicking draws a top-down view of the surrounding terrain into an active filled map.

name: Enchanted Golden Apple
description: A rare legendary food item found in dungeon, desert temple, and Ancient City chests. Grants powerful buffs including Regeneration, Absorption, Resistance, and Fire Resistance.

name: End Crystal
description: A mystical crystal found atop obsidian pillars in the End that heals the Ender Dragon. Can be crafted and placed on the bedrock exit portal to resummon the dragon.

name: Eye of Ender
description: A magical talisman crafted from an ender pearl and blaze powder. Locates underground strongholds and activates End Portal frames.

name: Bottle o' Enchanting
description: A glass phial filled with concentrated experience orbs. When thrown, it shatters on impact to release experience points for enchanting and repairing gear.

name: Explorer Pottery Sherd
description: An ancient ceramic shard excavated from suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins. Used to craft decorated pots featuring a compass and map motif.

name: Eye Armor Trim Smithing Template
description: A rare smithing template discovered in Stronghold altar and library chests. Used at a smithing table to etch the Eye trim design into armor pieces.

name: Firework Rocket
description: A pyrotechnic rocket crafted from paper and gunpowder. Used for aerial visual displays or held to propel players wearing elytra through the skies.

name: Firework Star
description: A crafted pyrotechnic pellet made from gunpowder and dyes. Determines the explosion shape, color, and particle effects of a firework rocket.

name: Fishing Rod
description: A versatile tool crafted from sticks and string used to catch fish, junk, and treasure from water bodies. Can also hook and reel in entities.

name: Flower Banner Pattern
description: A reusable banner pattern crafted with paper and an oxeye daisy. Used in a loom to apply the Flower Charge symbol to banners.

name: Flower Pot
description: A decorative container crafted from three bricks. Holds and displays saplings, flowers, mushrooms, cacti, and other small vegetation.

name: Friend Pottery Sherd
description: An ancient ceramic shard excavated from suspicious gravel in trail ruins. Used to craft decorated pots with an engraving of humanoid figures standing together.

name: Minecart with Furnace
description: A rail vehicle fitted with a coal-fueled furnace engine. Pushes other minecarts forward along tracks without requiring powered rails.

name: Glistering Melon Slice
description: An alchemical brewing ingredient crafted from a melon slice and eight gold nuggets. Used in brewing stands to brew Potions of Healing.

name: Globe Banner Pattern
description: A reusable decorative stencil obtained by trading with master cartographer villagers. Used in a loom to apply the detailed globe emblem onto banners.

name: Glow Item Frame
description: A luminescent wall-mounted display fixture crafted from an item frame and a glow ink sac. Displays items and blocks brightly even in complete darkness.

name: Glowstone Dust
description: A glowing mineral dust harvested by mining crystalline glowstone clusters in the Nether. Used to craft glowstone blocks and amplify potion tiers in brewing.

name: Goat Horn
description: An anatomical mob drop obtained when an adult goat rams into natural solid blocks. Playing it produces a loud, resonant call heard across long distances.

name: Golden Axe
description: A lustrous logging tool and heavy melee weapon forged from gold ingots and sticks. Chops wood at extreme speed with high enchantability but low durability.

name: Golden Boots
description: Protective footwear fashioned from four gold ingots. Provides modest physical defense and pacifies aggressive piglins in the Nether.

name: Golden Chestplate
description: A gleaming torso armor piece crafted from eight gold ingots. Offers five points of armor defense and prevents piglin hostility.

name: Golden Helmet
description: Protective headgear fashioned from five gold ingots. Shields the wearer from head damage and keeps piglins neutral in the Nether.

name: Golden Hoe
description: An agricultural implement forged from two gold ingots and sticks. Rapidly tills soil into farmland and breaks sculk or organic blocks with high speed.

name: Golden Horse Armor
description: Durable equine barding found inside dungeon, temple, and fortress chests. Equips onto a tamed horse to grant seven defense points without consuming durability.

name: Golden Leggings
description: Protective greaves fashioned from seven gold ingots. Provides three points of armor protection while satisfying piglin gold requirements.

name: Golden Pickaxe
description: A mining tool forged from three gold ingots and sticks. Boasts the fastest block-breaking speed of any tier, offset by very low durability.

name: Golden Shovel
description: A lightweight excavation spade crafted from a gold ingot and two sticks. Digs through dirt, gravel, and sand with exceptional velocity.

name: Golden Sword

name: Gray Dye
